reminder.title: A little reminder
reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.

facts.title: Did you know?
facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.

quotes.title: Words to live by
quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.

jokes.title: Just for fun
jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.

session.footnote: How long a run lasts and what happens afterwards live on the Grind page, in the plan sentence.
session.leaveDutyHelp: Once the results screen appears, wait this long before leaving the duty. 0 leaves as soon as the match ends.
session.requeueHelp: Waits a random time in this range before queueing the next match; re-queueing the instant a match ends looks robotic. 0 – 0 queues immediately.
session.takeBreaksHelp: Idle for a while every so often, the way a person steps away between sessions.
session.breakLengthHelp: Roughly how long each break lasts, varied by ±20% each time.

combat.introMovement: Behavior controls movement only: where to stand and when to back off.
combat.introRotation: Your rotation plugin presses the skills; the required Auto PVP LB plugin fires the Limit Break, auto-configured for your class.
combat.rotationPluginHelp: Which plugin presses your combat skills during matches.
combat.behaviorHelp: How the bot positions itself and picks its fights.
combat.smartTargetingHelpOn: On: this plugin decides who to attack. It joins the team's focus target, prefers low-HP and squishy enemies (healers first), and skips anyone with Guard up.
combat.smartTargetingHelpManual: RotationSolver runs in manual mode and presses skills on that target; another rotation plugin must attack your current target.
combat.smartTargetingHelpOff: Off: the rotation plugin picks targets itself (RotationSolver uses lowest HP in range).
combat.reactionTimeHelp: Adds a human reaction delay before the bot changes what it's doing.
combat.recordMatchesHelp: Writes every brain decision (positions, HP, posture, reason) to a per-match log file in the plugin folder,
combat.recordMatchesHelpSize: for reviewing and tuning how it played. Roughly 1 MB per match; only the last 30 matches are kept.

rotation.rsrHelp: Auto-installed and driven by this plugin; skills, Guard, and Purify are handled for you. The recommended default.
rotation.manualHelp: Bring your own rotation plugin (e.g. Wrath Combo). It must press skills, Guard, and Purify itself; RotationSolver is no longer required.

strategy.rushHelp: No tactics: runs to the objective and stands on it. Never retreats; will feed when outnumbered.
strategy.defensiveHelp: Holds the point without diving, kites when focused, retreats below ~55% HP. Ranged and healers stay far back.
strategy.moderateHelp: Balanced: short chases when ahead, falls back when outnumbered, retreats below ~35% HP. A good default.
strategy.aggressiveHelp: Pushes the enemy line and chases kills; retreats only when nearly dead (~18% HP).
strategy.customHelp: Hand-tuned: every threshold below is yours to set. Starts from the Moderate baseline.

reaction.realisticHelp: ~140–380 ms reaction delay. A good default.

custom.retreatBelowHelp: When enemies are on you, or your side is outnumbered, and your HP drops under this, fall back to safety.
custom.rejoinAboveHelp: Once you have healed back above this much HP, return to the fight.
custom.alwaysFleeBelowHelp: If your HP drops under this, run for safety no matter what else is happening.
custom.heavyDamageHelp: If your HP is dropping faster than this each second, treat it as taking heavy damage and back off early.
custom.chaseAheadHelp: How much stronger your nearby side must be before you chase a kill. Wounded fighters count for less, and each enemy already dead counts as half a fighter. 0 = chase even fights; below 0 = chase even when slightly outnumbered.
custom.fallBackBehindHelp: How much stronger the nearby enemies must be before you retreat to your team. Wounded fighters count for less. 0 = fall back the moment they outnumber you.
custom.meleeHoldHelp: As melee or tank with no one to chase, how far from the crystal to stand.
custom.meleeChaseHelp: As melee or tank chasing a target, how close to get before attacking.
custom.rangedHoldHelp: As ranged or healer holding position, how far behind the crystal to stand.
custom.rangedAttackHelp: As ranged or healer, how far from your target to stand while attacking.
custom.keepBackHelp: While waiting for teammates to arrive, keep at least this far from the enemy group.
custom.inDangerAtHelp: How many enemies aiming at you before you count as in danger. Works with Retreat below: the more attackers, the sooner you fall back.
custom.sidestepAtHelp: When at least this many enemies are aiming at you, sidestep to safety even at full HP.
custom.sidestepDistanceHelp: When enemies focus you, how far to move in one sidestep, toward whatever spot is safest and closest to your team.
custom.retreatStepHelp: How far each step of a retreat takes you. The direction is chosen to slip past enemies, stay near your team, and break their line of sight.
custom.backupRangeHelp: A teammate within this distance counts as backup. With nobody inside it, you act as if you are alone.
custom.enemyNearRangeHelp: Enemies within this distance of you count toward being outnumbered.
custom.fightZoneHelp: The area around the crystal used to judge who is winning the fight. When no enemy is inside it, the point counts as free and you stand on it to push.
custom.maxChaseHelp: Never chase a target further than this from the crystal. Enemies past it are ignored.
custom.maxFromTeamHelp: Never wander further than this from the middle of your team.
custom.resetDefaultsHelp: Sets every value above back to the Moderate baseline. Hold Ctrl and click to confirm.

match.sayHelloHelp: Sends /quickchat Hello once during the portrait phase, at a random moment so it doesn't look scripted.
match.helloChanceHelp: How often the hello actually fires. Lower means it sometimes stays silent.
match.helloAfterHelp: Waits a random time in this range after the portraits appear, so the greeting never fires the instant the intro starts.
match.emotesHelp: Plays a random friendly emote (wave, cheer, salute, and the like) at a random moment of the pre-match countdown, sometimes twice. Waits until your character is free so the emote actually plays.
match.goodMatchHelp: Sends /quickchat "Good Match" when the results screen appears at the end of a match.
match.goodMatchChanceHelp: How often "Good Match" actually fires after a match.
match.goodMatchAfterHelp: Waits a random time in this range after the results screen appears. If it lands later than "Leave duty after" (under Session), the bot leaves first and skips the goodbye.
